entities.summary: Jesus 'Kiki' Rojas is a Venezuelan former professional boxer who competed from 1985 to 2004. He is a world champion in two weight classes, having held the World Boxing Association (WBA) flyweight title from 1989 to 1990 and the WBA super flyweight title from 1998 to 1999.

entities.summary: Jesus 'Kiki' Rojas is a Venezuelan former professional boxer who competed from 1985 to 2004. He is a world champion in two weight classes, having held the World Boxing Association (WBA) flyweight title from 1989 to 1990 and the WBA super flyweight title from 1998 to 1999.
